subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Joins sentences using conjunctions ('and', 'but'); uses varied vocabulary

show.line: Two short sentences can join hands. I like tea. I like coffee. I like tea and coffee! And joins them.

rounds.prompt: I like apples. I do not like pears. Which word joins them best?
rounds.praise: Yes! I like apples but I do not like pears.

rounds.prompt: Thabo runs. Thabo jumps. Which word joins them?
The sun is out ... it is cold. And or but? Say the word.
I was tired, ... I finished my homework. Which word fits?
rounds.praise: Yes! Tired, but I finished anyway.

rounds.prompt: Join with and, or join with but? Sort the sentence pairs.
Read this long sentence out loud.
rounds.text: I wanted to swim but the pool was closed.
accept: i wanted to swim but the pool was closed

hints: And adds more of the same. But shows something different.
Say both sentences. Which joining word sounds right?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I like dogs. I am scared of cats.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I like dogs and I am scared of cats!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Those two ideas are different. I like dogs but I am scared of cats.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's join them together. I like dogs, but I am scared of cats!

parent_line: Can join two sentences with and or but.
